title: Never investigated
representation: NO ROW. Absence of a row is the representation; no placeholder row, no UNKNOWN classification, no NULL row created to signal that research has not happened.

title: Draft candidate DIRECT_EQUIVALENT
representation: row; knowledge_source_version_id present; external_classification_id present; review_state='draft'; mapping_outcome='DIRECT_EQUIVALENT'

title: Under-review RELATED_TO
representation: row; source version present; external classification present; review_state='under_review'

title: Approved DIRECT_EQUIVALENT
representation: classification REQUIRED; approved attribution required

title: Approved NO_DIRECT_MAPPING
representation: source version required; classification NULL; review_state='approved'

title: Draft NO_DIRECT_MAPPING proposal
representation: PERMITTED: source version required; classification NULL; review_state='draft'. Expresses a concrete proposition about an authority/edition. MUST NOT be presented as a governed conclusion until approved.

title: Rejected NO_DIRECT_MAPPING proposal
representation: retained as historical rejected proposition; never returned as approved truth

title: Mapped outcome with NULL classification
representation: INVALID — rejected by the outcome-coherence constraint

title: NO_DIRECT_MAPPING with classification
representation: INVALID — rejected by the outcome-coherence constraint

title: Crosswalk with NULL source version
representation: INVALID — knowledge_source_version_id is mandatory on every row

title: New standard edition
representation: new knowledge_source_version; historical relationship remains auditable (immutable; superseded by back-link)

title: External concept exists but mapping evidence weak
representation: may remain candidate/unapproved; never becomes approved truth automatically

title: AI-generated candidate
representation: candidate only; human governance required; AI can never approve

title: Customer classification
representation: NOT represented by the global crosswalk; separate future tenant-scoped alias layer keyed to the same equipment_type

title: Tenant-scoped source referenced by global crosswalk
representation: future implementation guard MUST reject it (mandatory, non-omittable)

title: Multiple standards relate to one Type
representation: multiple approved crosswalk rows with distinct knowledge_source_version_id

title: One external classification relates to multiple Atiman Types
representation: multiple crosswalk rows referencing the same external_classification_id

title: Customer-specific classification can later exist without contaminating global identity
representation: not recorded here; a separate tenant-scoped customer-alias layer keyed to the same equipment_type_id; global crosswalk never gains a tenant column

title: AI-generated proposal remains distinguishable from human-approved truth
representation: ai_assisted=true + ai_assistance_detail; review_state cannot reach 'approved' without approved_by_user_id (human)

title: External classification absent without being falsely interpreted as NO_DIRECT_MAPPING
representation: external_classification_id IS NULL alone carries no meaning: meaning comes from mapping_outcome + review_state; unapproved rows are never a conclusion
note: The coherence CHECK makes NDM-with-classification and mapping-without-classification unrepresentable.

title: NO_DIRECT_MAPPING records which authority/version was actually reviewed
representation: knowledge_source_version_id is NOT NULL on every crosswalk row, including NDM rows
note: This is the direct answer to the mission question: the investigated authority is known without inventing a fake classification.

title: DIRECT_EQUIVALENT cannot be inferred merely from matching labels
representation: DIRECT_EQUIVALENT is an explicitly chosen, evidence-backed, separately approved value; never derived from code/label similarity

title: Evidence remains traceable after supersession
representation: evidence rows are historical records; source-version FK is ON DELETE RESTRICT; supersession does not delete evidence

title: Duplicate simultaneously active approved relationships can be constrained
representation: partial unique index on (equipment_type_id, external_classification_id, relationship) WHERE approved AND not superseded AND classification NOT NULL; plus one active approved NDM per (type, edition)

title: Queries can distinguish current vs historical relationships
representation: filter superseded_by_crosswalk_id IS NULL for current; non-null for historical
